name: GFP chromophore (HBDI)
description: p-Hydroxybenzylidene-imidazolinone, the Z-isomer that forms inside GFP.

name: GFP (wild-type, 2WUR)
description: Aequorea victoria GFP, 0.9 Å X-ray structure. Abs 395/475 / Em 509 nm.

name: EGFP (2Y0G)
description: Enhanced GFP (F64L/S65T). Abs 488 / Em 507 nm. The standard green FP.

name: mCherry (2H5Q)
description: Monomeric red FP derived from DsRed. Abs 587 / Em 610 nm.
